title: Licking pennies
html_source:
Pica is characterized by an appetite for substances that are largely non-nutritive, such as ice, paper, clay, drywall or paint, metal, chalk, soil, glass, or sand…Pica is more commonly seen in women and children. Particularly it is seen in pregnant women, small children, and those with developmental disabilities such as autism.
